endpoint_determination._question: Does this paper contain ANY cargo-expression measurement?
endpoint_determination.borderline_called_explicitly: Fig 4b,c reports the % of cells positive for an aVHH PSEUDOGENE built from scRNA-seq reads. That counts cargo mRNA molecules, not expressed protein, it is reported per transcriptional cluster for one LNP, and no per-formulation value table exists. Marked inadmissible.
evidence: Cre mRNA is the cargo of every LNP in the screens and of Cat-/Neu-/An-LNP individually. SI Methods: mRNA was transcribed from a pMA7 construct with full N1-methyl-pseudouridine substitution, Cap1, enzymatic polyadenylation.

The readout is GENOMIC RECOMBINATION: Ai14 reporter mice, in which Cre protein translated from the delivered mRNA excises a Lox-Stop cassette and the cell becomes tdTomato+. Main text: 'functional mRNA delivery is quantified as the percentage of tdTomato+ cells'. That is downstream of translation, so it is cargo expression, not particle arrival.
A second cargo-expression readout exists: Fig S17 measures % aVHH+ cells and aVHH MFI by flow cytometry after delivering mRNA encoding a GPI-anchored VHH -- protein abundance.
The corpus already carries this readout convention: SX_2025 has 141 in-vivo rows at Model_type = Mouse_Ai14 with Experiment_method = editing_efficiency_normalized.
endpoint_determination.what_the_title_refers_to_is_NOT_delivery: Figures 4a and 5 and Supplementary Figures 20-22 are single-cell RNA-seq of the LUNG'S OWN transcriptome one hour after injection -- 27 clusters, 243/145 differentially expressed genes vs PBS, 27 of 835 Reactome pathways. That is what the tissue does ABOUT the particle. It is recorded in 05_values.csv as corpus_admissible = no.

figS6c_pool_shares_sum_to_100._interpretation: Each column is a SHARE OF ITS OWN POOL and the shares sum to 100%. Fig S3a states it as a worked example: 3, 1 and 1 of five sequenced barcodes give 60, 20 and 20, which sums to 100.000 with residual 0.000 and reproduces as 3/5, 1/5, 1/5 exactly. The residuals here are all POSITIVE and are attributable to exactly one pooled LNP missing from the table: the text says 23 cationic LNPs were pooled and the table lists 22. The three organ residuals average to 6.5528, which equals the 'average' column residual to 3e-4 -- the same arithmetic identity the column itself obeys.

centred_replicate_marker_width_sweep.verdict: NOT CREDITED: widths [18] changed the value. MEASURED LIMITATION, stated rather than glossed: on an 18 px bar the flank test has almost no room to operate. A marker must cover >= 90% of the bar to get past the coverage rule, i.e. >= 17 px, and a centred marker that wide already covers both 5 px flanks -- so the two guards do not overlap at this bar width and the protection here is the coverage rule alone. The flank test earns its keep on wider bars; it is not what is holding this panel up.

the_three_numbers.formulation_design: 18 helper lipids x 2 PEG-lipids (C14PEG2K, C18PEG2K) x 4 molar ratios = 144
the_three_numbers.second_PEG_lipid_identity: C18PEG2K. Named NOWHERE in the article text or the SI Methods ('PEGs, cholesterol, and helper lipids ... purchased from Avanti Lipids'), and recoverable only from the PEG column of the Fig S6 tables.
the_three_numbers.what_the_design_can_support: ONE ionizable-lipid structure. Every one of the 144 formulations uses cKK-E12; what varies is the helper lipid, the PEG-lipid and the molar ratio. A corpus keyed on ionizable-lipid structure gains one lipid from this paper, however many rows are emitted.
